title: ReducedConstantLowerShriekReductionData
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], f:X → Spec k a separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], X reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], j:U → X an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and r a prime. Put R=ULift(Z/rZ) and let R_U/(r) denote the constant R-module sheaf with value R/(r) [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define ReducedConstantLowerShriekReductionData(f,j,r) to mean the following existential proposition. There exist a scheme Y, a finite surjective morphism ν:Y → X [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism], a dense open V of X, a scheme U′, morphisms j′:U′ → Y and ν′:U′ → U, such that ν followed by f is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], ν restricted over V is an isomorphism, j′ is an open immersion, the square (j′,ν′,ν,j) is cartesian [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and j′_! R_U′/(r) [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] satisfies the eight assertions for Y → Spec k [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions].
